summary: DarkIris Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 21, 2026, announcing an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) to be held on August 6, 2026. The proposals include increasing authorized share capital from US$50,000 to US$500 million, a voting rights increase for Class B shares from 20 to 150 votes per share, and authorizing a share consolidation within a 2:1 to 3,000:1 range, to be determined by the board over two years. This is a routine capital structure adjustment for a foreign private issuer. There are no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation elements. The filing is a standard corporate governance matter with no immediate transaction or strategic change.
